name: Cherico
description: French organic chicory brand founded in 2023 by the former co-founders of brasserie Gallia (sold to Heineken 2021). Positioned as a modern, bio, premium alternative to coffee. Produced in Ploeuc-L-Hermitage, Bretagne. HQ Paris 11e. Shopify merchant available via Agentic Storefronts from March 2026.

productionLocation.name: Ploeuc-L-Hermitage, Bretagne, France
productionLocation.description: Micro-torréfaction et production. Chicorée srced from Northern France and Europe.
